name: client-2026-quest-exp-u64
summary: 2026 client: the quest reward window shows quest EXP as 64 bits (QuestReward.Flag + Undefined0), not just the low 32.
status: BUILT 2026-09-24, not yet seen in a live client.
why: RewardWin (Game/RewardWin.nif) fills its reward lines in 0x697D20: it fetches the quest's QuestReward rows
(0x6989F0) and switches on RewardType (jump table 0x697FDC, case 0 = EXP at 0x697DB0). A QuestReward row is
packed: +0 ID u16, +2 Selectable, +3 RewardType u32, +7 Flag, +0xB Undefined0, +0xF Undefined1.
The EXP line object already holds a 64-BIT amount - low at +0x18, high at +0x1C - but the high half is a
The patch takes the high dword from Undefined0 instead, in the same 7 bytes:
Fiesta2026on2016 writes rewards above 2^32 as Flag = low / Undefined0 = high (0 on every stock row, so a stock
table shows exactly what it showed before), and the server side is the zone plugin quest_exp, which grants
the same 64-bit value. It also fixes the stock display of the 42 rewards in [2^31, 2^32) only in so far as
the line was already 64-bit: the low dword is taken as-is, unsigned, into a zero-extended value.
No relocation touches these bytes. Other places that show quest EXP (if any) are not covered - only this window.

edits.why: mov eax,[esi+0xB] + first byte of mov [ecx+0x1C],eax, over the first 4 bytes of mov dword [ecx+0x1C],0
modrm byte of mov [ecx+0x1C],eax, over the immediate's 2nd byte
disp8 0x1C + nop, over the immediate's last 2 bytes
